name: zsnd_sample_destroy_owned_data
description: zSndSample::DestroyOwnedData frees runtime-owned marker arrays, quality-variant names, duplicate voice handles, backend buffers, and clears replay flag bit 0x08 without freeing the sample object.
known_limits: The native smoke covers the createGuard early return and no-backend-owned-data path; backend voice release branches are source-reviewed against Binary Ninja and covered separately by sound backend handle smokes.
tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zSound playback class pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4a3690 validates null/createGuard rejection, marker and variant-name frees, duplicate voice cleanup, backend-specific primary voice release, duplicateVoiceCount reset, duplicateVoices clearing, primary backend clearing, replay flag bit 0x08 clearing, and success/failure returns.
The native smoke checks createGuard rejection, heap-owned marker and variant-name cleanup, duplicateVoiceCount reset, duplicateVoices clearing, primary backend clearing, and replay flag bit clearing.
